title: The Dead Magic Island
summary: On an island where powers and Titans don’t work, the Spirals are searching a volcano for the Legendary Titan, Phoenix. To stop them, our heroes with Montehue and Tersly must first destroy the very thing that makes powers inactive: the Lodestone.

sections.heading: Plot
sections.wikitext:
'''The Race for Phoenix''' At the [[Blood Spiral Base]], [[the Betrayer]] orders [[Rassimov]] to recover the Legendary Titan of Rebirth, [[Phoenix]], hidden within a volcanic island in [[:Category:Indonesia|Indonesia]]. The site is shielded by a mysterious anti-magic field that negates all [[Seeker]] powers including the invocation of [[Titan]]. Rassimov assures him that [[Shauna]] and [[Wind]] have already located the [[Phoenix Volcano]] and are searching for the [[Amulet]]. [[File:S2E44 Montehue Tersly Huntik team.png.png|thumb|the Huntik team meet up with [[Montehue]] and [[Tersly]]]] Meanwhile,[[Montehue]] and [[Tersly]] arrive on the island and meet the Huntik team. They decode one of [[Nostradamus]]'s lost quatrains from Eathon's [[Holotome]]: ''"The lost daughter rises from red ashes
only when the drought comes to an end.
The underworld holds the answer,
but a stone with three sides threatens all."'' The team realize that the "drought" refers to the absence of magic caused by an ancient Casterwill artifact called the [[Lodestone]], which was left to protect Phoenix. To reach Phoenix and take on the [[Blood Spiral]], the team must enter the island's underground passages and destroy the stone. '''Skirmish in the Lava Tube''' [[File:S2E44 Shadow Kuolit Fenris.png|thumb|[[Fenris]] tries to dispatch [[Shadow Kuolit]]]] As the team venture through the jungle, they are ambushed by a group of [[Casterwill Hunters]], with Lok, Sophie and Cherit sent tumbling into an underground lava tube. While Sophie and Cherit are trapped under a log, another Hunter emerges from the darkness and fights with Lok and [[Kipperin]]. The Hunter summons [[Dark Pharaoh]] while Sophie summons [[Sabriel]]. On the surface, Dante and Montehue work together to take out the Spirals. Montehue invokes [[Fenris]] who clashes with the Hunter's [[Shadow Kuolit]]. Although Fenris floors the enermy Titan, it can use its shadows to attack which catches Fenris by surprise. Montehue rescues Tersly and Den, and Dante invokes [[Caliban]] who outsmarts Shadow Kuolit by standing directly in sunlight and using his shadow to counter and defeat the Titan. One of the Spirals ruthlessly sacrifices [[Nighlurker]] to power up her [[Bladewave]], causing the lava tube to collapse in on itself, but Lok manges to carry Sophie and Cherit to safety. Using [[Red Searcher]] and [[Kaioh the Tracker]] to scout ahead, the team search for the entrance to the underground passage. However, as soon as they step into the Lodestone's radius, their active Titans are sent back to their Amulets and their spells fail completely. Because Cherit can't enter the vicinity, he is forced to stay behind. The team find the door to cave and descend into the labyrinth while Tersly stations himself outside the entrance. '''Into the Labyrinth''' Lok, Dante, Sophie, and Den venture into a subterranean maze but even the [[Holotome]] is neutralized because it is Seeker technology. They soon attacked by a group of ancient stone [[Lodestone Guardian|creatures]] that have activated to defend the maze. Without access to magic or Titans, the team resort to hand-to-hand combat and martial arts, with Montehue using his axes to smash the stone constructs. [[File:S2E44 Montehue Lodestone guardians.png|thumb|Montehue is surrounded by the [[Lodestone Guardian]]s]] As the group navigates deeper, they realize the maze walls are shifting continuously in a cyclic pattern to keep intruders walking in circles. Lok decrypts the final line of Nostradamus's riddle - "the stone with three sides" - and recalls a large triangular stone set on a pedestal near the entrance chamber. The team rush back to where they they entered but a swarm of the Lodestone guardians corner them, now led by a larger leader variant. Dante, Montehue, Sophie and Den hold off the guardians with pure physical defense while Lok tries to shatter the Lodestone but to no avail. Meanwhile, Tersly tries to navigate the team via radio. He is noticed by a nearby [[Lioness|lioness]], forcing him to hide behind a rock while it takes interest in his equipment before advancing on him. Tersly desperately tries to summon [[Venadek]] but can't due to the anti-magic field. '''Ending the Drought''' [[File:S2E44 Lok Lodestone guard.jpg|thumb|Lok struggles against a Lodestone Guardian]] The Huntik team are overpowered and out of time, and Dante is injured taking a hit to protect Den. As Lok tries to help, he is grabbed by one of the constructs. During the struggle the pair topple over onto the Lodestone, and the weight of the guardian shatters the triangular relic. the anti-magic field collapses, instantly restoring magic across the island, with Tersly finally managing to summon Venadek who scares off the lioness just in time. Lok summons the [[Willblade]] and turns the tide on the remaining constructs, saving the team. The group reconvene with Tersly outside the maze, and Dante uses [[Everfight]] to heal from his injury. Knowing the Blood Spirals are still unaware that the anti-magic field is down, the Huntik team prepares to launch a surprise counter-attack to claim the Amulet of Phoenix. Meanwhile, a bored Cherit waits for the team and hopes they haven't forgotten about him...

Rassimov assures him that Shauna and Wind have already located the Phoenix Volcano and are searching for the Amulet. 
 and Tersly]]

Into the Labyrinth

As the group navigates deeper, they realize the maze walls are shifting continuously in a cyclic pattern to keep intruders walking in circles. Lok decrypts the final line of Nostradamus's riddle - "the stone with three sides" - and recalls a large triangular stone set on a pedestal near the entrance chamber. sections.heading: Production Errors
sections.wikitext:
*When Sophie summons [[Sabriel|Powerbonded Sabriel]], her non-Powerbonded icon is incorrectly shown.
*[[Shadow Kuolit]] is invoked by a male [[Casterwill Hunters|Casterwill Hunter]]; however, when that same Titan is defeated, it returns to the amulet of a different, female Casterwill Hunter.
*In the French dub, a single line said by Dante while [[Caliban]] fights Shadow Kuolit is pronounced by a different voice actor.

full_text:
Lok leads the Huntik team in a mission to Romania to capture the wild Titan, Antedeluvian. However, Harrison has already bonded to the Titan, and is waiting for them. Lok fails to invoke Pendragon to save them but, luckily, Dante returns from his secret training in time, defeating Tantras with a new power, Copykind.

plot_sections.wikitext:
'''The Race for Phoenix''' At the [[Blood Spiral Base]], [[the Betrayer]] orders [[Rassimov]] to recover the Legendary Titan of Rebirth, [[Phoenix]], hidden within a volcanic island in [[:Category:Indonesia|Indonesia]]. The site is shielded by a mysterious anti-magic field that negates all [[Seeker]] powers including the invocation of [[Titan]]. Rassimov assures him that [[Shauna]] and [[Wind]] have already located the [[Phoenix Volcano]] and are searching for the [[Amulet]]. [[File:S2E44 Montehue Tersly Huntik team.png.png|thumb|the Huntik team meet up with [[Montehue]] and [[Tersly]]]] Meanwhile,[[Montehue]] and [[Tersly]] arrive on the island and meet the Huntik team. They decode one of [[Nostradamus]]'s lost quatrains from Eathon's [[Holotome]]: ''"The lost daughter rises from red ashes
only when the drought comes to an end.
The underworld holds the answer,
but a stone with three sides threatens all."'' The team realize that the "drought" refers to the absence of magic caused by an ancient Casterwill artifact called the [[Lodestone]], which was left to protect Phoenix. To reach Phoenix and take on the [[Blood Spiral]], the team must enter the island's underground passages and destroy the stone. '''Skirmish in the Lava Tube''' [[File:S2E44 Shadow Kuolit Fenris.png|thumb|[[Fenris]] tries to dispatch [[Shadow Kuolit]]]] As the team venture through the jungle, they are ambushed by a group of [[Casterwill Hunters]], with Lok, Sophie and Cherit sent tumbling into an underground lava tube. While Sophie and Cherit are trapped under a log, another Hunter emerges from the darkness and fights with Lok and [[Kipperin]]. The Hunter summons [[Dark Pharaoh]] while Sophie summons [[Sabriel]]. On the surface, Dante and Montehue work together to take out the Spirals. Montehue invokes [[Fenris]] who clashes with the Hunter's [[Shadow Kuolit]]. Although Fenris floors the enermy Titan, it can use its shadows to attack which catches Fenris by surprise. Montehue rescues Tersly and Den, and Dante invokes [[Caliban]] who outsmarts Shadow Kuolit by standing directly in sunlight and using his shadow to counter and defeat the Titan. One of the Spirals ruthlessly sacrifices [[Nighlurker]] to power up her [[Bladewave]], causing the lava tube to collapse in on itself, but Lok manges to carry Sophie and Cherit to safety. Using [[Red Searcher]] and [[Kaioh the Tracker]] to scout ahead, the team search for the entrance to the underground passage. However, as soon as they step into the Lodestone's radius, their active Titans are sent back to their Amulets and their spells fail completely. Because Cherit can't enter the vicinity, he is forced to stay behind. The team find the door to cave and descend into the labyrinth while Tersly stations himself outside the entrance. '''Into the Labyrinth''' Lok, Dante, Sophie, and Den venture into a subterranean maze but even the [[Holotome]] is neutralized because it is Seeker technology. They soon attacked by a group of ancient stone [[Lodestone Guardian|creatures]] that have activated to defend the maze. Without access to magic or Titans, the team resort to hand-to-hand combat and martial arts, with Montehue using his axes to smash the stone constructs. [[File:S2E44 Montehue Lodestone guardians.png|thumb|Montehue is surrounded by the [[Lodestone Guardian]]s]] As the group navigates deeper, they realize the maze walls are shifting continuously in a cyclic pattern to keep intruders walking in circles. Lok decrypts the final line of Nostradamus's riddle - "the stone with three sides" - and recalls a large triangular stone set on a pedestal near the entrance chamber. The team rush back to where they they entered but a swarm of the Lodestone guardians corner them, now led by a larger leader variant. Dante, Montehue, Sophie and Den hold off the guardians with pure physical defense while Lok tries to shatter the Lodestone but to no avail. Meanwhile, Tersly tries to navigate the team via radio. He is noticed by a nearby [[Lioness|lioness]], forcing him to hide behind a rock while it takes interest in his equipment before advancing on him. Tersly desperately tries to summon [[Venadek]] but can't due to the anti-magic field. '''Ending the Drought''' [[File:S2E44 Lok Lodestone guard.jpg|thumb|Lok struggles against a Lodestone Guardian]] The Huntik team are overpowered and out of time, and Dante is injured taking a hit to protect Den. As Lok tries to help, he is grabbed by one of the constructs. During the struggle the pair topple over onto the Lodestone, and the weight of the guardian shatters the triangular relic. the anti-magic field collapses, instantly restoring magic across the island, with Tersly finally managing to summon Venadek who scares off the lioness just in time. Lok summons the [[Willblade]] and turns the tide on the remaining constructs, saving the team. The group reconvene with Tersly outside the maze, and Dante uses [[Everfight]] to heal from his injury. Knowing the Blood Spirals are still unaware that the anti-magic field is down, the Huntik team prepares to launch a surprise counter-attack to claim the Amulet of Phoenix. Meanwhile, a bored Cherit waits for the team and hopes they haven't forgotten about him...

The Huntik team are overpowered and out of time, and Dante is injured taking a hit to protect Den. As Lok tries to help, he is grabbed by one of the constructs. Knowing the Blood Spirals are still unaware that the anti-magic field is down, the Huntik team prepares to launch a surprise counter-attack to claim the Amulet of Phoenix.
